defs.doc: Decode only the local credential data; the surrounding Respo cursor map can legitimately retain mixed Tag/String/Number child keys, as defined by respo.core/>>. Do not cast or decode that heterogeneous key space into Tag-only state.
Native domain model; legacy storage/wire is still Map through database-to-wire. extra preserves unknown root fields such as prototype :pages.
Typed native session. Router and message interoperability maps remain explicit reviewed boundaries; unknown session fields survive decode/encode via extra.
Typed stored account, with Option only inside the native model. extra preserves unknown non-core account fields; wire uses the original Map fields and nil for absent nickname/avatar.

Decode the two-string legacy login List or rebuild the checked Credentials field shape from an in-memory Struct/Map during Reel replay. Existing Structs must first be converted to a Map: decode-map-as does not accept a Struct directly. No assertion or cast substitutes for field checking.

Legacy wire/state field boundary: decode Some payloads and send missing fields to the same decoder as nil. Preserve old nil/default/error behavior; generic T is the actual decoder result, not a cast of unknown data.

Decode legacy missing/nil wire fields into typed Option, invoking the payload decoder only for present non-nil values. A nullability normalization at the legacy Map boundary, not a cast or a new fallback value.
Reel stores heterogeneous historical record cells. Decode real session/id/time types at replay instead of claiming updater accepts arbitrary values or preserves an unrelated generic Db.
